f9eb198cf2.why: The byte calculation must preserve the final subtraction's CF and ZF while also producing the required RSI and aligned RDI values.

8b86b63bc1.rewrite:
pcmpeqb xmm1,XMMWORD PTR [rdi]
pmovmskb eax,xmm1
sar eax,cl
mov cl,dl
mov edx,0x1
shl edx,cl
sub edx,0x1
and eax,edx
8b86b63bc1.why: AND already sets ZF from the final EAX value, so the following TEST is redundant.

1002cdb66c.rewrite:
movdqa xmm2,XMMWORD PTR [rdi+0x10]
pcmpeqb xmm2,xmm1
pmovmskb eax,xmm2
mov cl,dh
mov edx,0x1
shl edx,cl
sub edx,0x1
and eax,edx
1002cdb66c.why: AND and the following TEST produce identical CF, PF, ZF, SF, and OF values, so TEST can be removed.

4d439432d6.why: TEST is necessary because a zero effective shift count leaves ZF unchanged, and all preceding register results must be preserved.

9bb70bf6cc.why: Both AVX2 stores, the final RDI update, and the independent comparison flags are required.

486cf16a65.why: Both AVX2 stores, the RDI subtraction, and the flags from comparing RDX with 0x100 are required.

2087cc59bf.why: The four stores already use the maximum AVX2 width, and the RDX update and comparison each have required results.

18028301ae.why: Four AVX2 stores are needed for the 128 bytes, and VZEROUPPER changes upper halves of preserved YMM registers.

528b09a11f.rewrite:
vmovd xmm1,esi
lea rsi,[rdi+rdx*1]
mov rax,rdi
vpbroadcastb xmm0,xmm1
cmp rdx,0x10
528b09a11f.why: VPBROADCASTB replaces zeroing XMM0 and shuffling the low byte of XMM1, with the same zeroed upper vector bits. VMOVD remains to preserve the required ZMM1 value.

c5b316cefb.why: Advancing RDI to the next 64-byte boundary needs both alignment operations, in addition to the required RSI update and store.

04bcc4fcdc.why: The four stores already use 512-bit vectors, and the final RDI value and comparison flags require the remaining instructions.

9809e27b86.why: The two alignment operations, two full-width stores, and independent RSI update all contribute required results.

e17f5ecb4e.why: LEA produces the required RCX value, both 512-bit stores are needed, and CMP supplies the required flags.

8c6866be1c.why: Four 512-bit stores are needed, and neither the required RDI update nor its subsequent comparison can be removed.

47ad781dc2.why: The scalar results and comparison flags are live, and combining the two stores would require duplicating YMM16 while preserving every ZMM register.

a8ffaa29d3.why: Wider stores would require duplicating YMM16 while preserving every ZMM register, and the pointer update and comparison remain necessary.

40bf1a9a9d.why: Both maximum-width SSE2 stores, the RDI update, and the independent comparison flags are required.

9d15be17f5.why: Both SSE2 stores, the final RDI adjustment, and the flags from comparing RDX with 0x80 are required.

5afbb1b3e2.why: Four SSE2 stores are needed for the 64 bytes, followed by the required RDX update and comparison.

7cbfa9ccc4.why: The comparison vectors, OR results, movemask, and updated pointer are all live, and TEST is needed to set ZF from the movemask.
